entries.title: Psalms 114:1
segments: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,

entries.title: Psalms 114:2
segments: Judah was His sanctuary, [and] Israel was His kingdom.

entries.title: Psalms 114:3
segments: The sea saw [it] and fled; Jordan was driven back.

entries.title: Psalms 114:4
segments: The mountains skipped like rams, [and] the little hills like lambs.

entries.title: Psalms 114:5
segments: What [ailed] you, O sea, [that] you fled? O Jordan, that you turned back,

entries.title: Psalms 114:6
segments: O mountains [that] skipped like rams, O little hills like lambs?

entries.title: Psalms 114:7
segments: Earth, tremble at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

entries.title: Psalms 114:8
segments: who turned the rock [into] a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
